title: spec review: GOAL: Skill Intelligence & Dynamic Specialist Agents program (P0 audit → registry + telemetry → compaction + triggers → shadow disclosure → skill scorecard → active routing → temporary specialists → quarantine/sandbox → learned skills → Jev routing → promotion)
spec: Program brief verbatim in .orchestrator/roadmap-skills.md (user, 2026-09-22 23:20). Shadow-first per P37; every stage keeps production behaviour unchanged until its mode is flipped on evidence. Child tasks carry the work; this task closes when the stages up to Jev routing and evidence-driven promotion are merged in shadow and the P36 evaluation suite passes.
acceptance: every child task merged or explicitly deferred with a reason in plan.md
tests/test_skill_eval.py (P36 suite) passes in the final checkpoint
retrospective recorded in .orchestrator/memory/decisions.md with revert paths

risks.issue: task/T-0865's checked-out branch equals origin/main (41be3d8), which is behind the packet's own stated base 887c13f4a66a and does not contain 887c13f4a66a's descendant work at all. .orchestrator/roadmap-skills.md, the file this spec calls its 'program brief verbatim' source, does not exist anywhere in this worktree's history — it was only ever committed on local main/goal/T-0861 (commit 7e3eade, unpushed). goal/T-0861 is confirmed to branch directly from 887c13f4a66a and does contain the file. This task was cut from the wrong parent; an executor working here cannot read the file the spec requires as ground truth.

Scope lists this file as writable, but the file's own committed header states 'this file changes only by the user.' Including a user-owned, read-only brief in an executor's write-scope risks an executor or Codex diff overwriting the verbatim program brief. Only .orchestrator/plan.md should be in write-scope; roadmap-skills.md should be reference-only.

depends_on is '(none)', but acceptance requires 'stages up to Jev routing and evidence-driven promotion' (S9/S10 in the existing P37 stage plan under GOAL T-0861) to be merged in shadow, and requires tests/test_skill_eval.py (P36) to pass — a file that does not exist anywhere in git history yet. With no depends_on link to T-0861 or to the specific child tasks that will produce S9/S10/P36, there is no structural gate proving those artifacts exist before this task is scored done; a reviewer/daemon has no mechanical way to verify the acceptance criterion, only prose in plan.md.

No revert path is stated for the plan.md/checkpoint commits this task will produce, despite the packet's own conditional instructions requiring one to be linked. Given the base-branch mismatch above, a naive revert of a plan.md commit made on the wrong branch could also silently diverge further from goal/T-0861's actual history.

suggested_spec_changes: Re-cut or rebase this task's worktree onto goal/T-0861 (not origin/main) before any edit, so .orchestrator/roadmap-skills.md and the current plan.md program state are actually present.

Drop .orchestrator/roadmap-skills.md from write-scope; keep it read-only per its own 'changes only by the user' header, scope only .orchestrator/plan.md for writes.
